home.title: TagAlong
home.tagline: Publish a group buy, share the link, buyers pay online. No account needed to join.

home.title: Overview
home.placeholder: Admin console. Merchants, listings, orders and the audit log arrive in M8.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields need fixing. Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.TURNSTILE_FAILED: The human check did not pass. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.LISTING_NOT_PUBLISHED: This listing is not open yet.
errors.MERCHANT_SUSPENDED: This seller is paused. Orders are not being accepted.
errors.MERCHANT_PROFILE_EXISTS: This account already has a seller profile.
errors.SLUG_TAKEN: That link name is taken. Choose another.
errors.MERCHANT_NOT_CHARGEABLE: Finish Stripe setup before publishing a paid listing.
errors.SOLD_OUT: Not enough left. The remaining amounts have been refreshed.
errors.ALREADY_REGISTERED: This email is already registered. The confirmation email has been resent.
errors.QTY_EXCEEDS_LIMIT: That is more than one order allows. Lower the quantity.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This changed in the meantime. Reload to see the latest state.
errors.FIELD_LOCKED_AFTER_PUBLISH: This field cannot change after publishing.
errors.CAPACITY_BELOW_SOLD: Capacity cannot go below what is already sold or reserved.
errors.OPTION_HAS_ORDERS: This option has orders. Turn it off instead of deleting it.
errors.SELF_CANCEL_WINDOW_PASSED: The self-cancel deadline has passed. Contact the seller.
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: The refund is more than what can still be refunded.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.STRIPE_ERROR: Stripe did not respond. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
